title: Paige Bueckers Joins Azzi Fudd and Ashanti Plummer to Talk Life, Love and Basketball in Today’s Episode of “Fudd Around And Find Out” From iHeart Women’s Sports and Unanimous Media
summary: iHeartMedia is a leading global media and entertainment company specializing in radio, digital, mobile, social, live events and on-demand entertainment.
body_markdown:
**WHAT:** iHeart Women’s Sports and Unanimous Media’s “[Fudd Around And Find Out](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-fudd-around-and-find-out-286260281/) ” will welcome Paige Bueckers as today’s special podcast guest.


In this episode, hosts Azzi Fudd and Ashanti Plummer will sit down with Bueckers, Fudd’s Dallas Wings teammate, for an extended conversation about basketball and life. The can’t-miss episode will feature world-class athletes talking about the sport they love – basketball – and will take time to reflect on relationships and friendships while in the public spotlight.


It’s the episode fans have been asking for. Fudd and Bueckers will argue about who won the last 1v1 and Bueckers will make her case that she’s the best golfer in the room. Fudd talks about the Final Four loss she still dreams about while Bueckers talks about her first WNBA playoffs, going from a gold medal in Berlin to a WNBA game three days later, and why she has a hard time celebrating herself. They will also share where things stand between them and what it’s like being teammates.


Plus, Fudd’s three-point contest win, what Bueckers picked up from Sue Bird but won’t fully share, UConn memories involving a sauna and Wordle, the Wings’ move to Dallas and much more.


**WHEN:** New episode of “[Fudd Around And Find Out](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-fudd-around-and-find-out-286260281/) ” with Paige Bueckers drops today, November 6, 2026, with new episodes weekly.


**WHERE:** “Fudd Around And Find Out” is published by iHeartPodcasts and is available now on the[iHeartRadio app](https://www.iheart.com/) ,[YouTube](https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2F%40FuddAroundPod&data=05%7C02%7CAlfredWarren%40iheartmedia.com%7Cd6e107712bc24d8969a808df3c29b010%7C122a527e5b714eba878d9810b495b9e3%7C0%7C0%7C639295821877744322%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=IJdHXN94%2FJg0xEmnQSIM2Futh0et%2BtQOE%2F8hphyvlEc%3D&reserved=0) and everywhere podcasts are heard.


**WHO:** Azzi Fudd is a guard for the Dallas Wings, selected No. 1 overall in the 2026 WNBA Draft. She became the first rookie in WNBA history to win the All-Star Three-Point Contest, set the franchise's rookie three-point record and ranked among the league's steals leaders. Fudd led the Huskies to the 2025 National Championship, earning Final Four Most Outstanding Player honors, then closed out her final UConn season as a First Team All-American. She graduated from UConn with her MBA. Off the court, Fudd co-hosts “Fudd Around and Find Out,” a weekly podcast produced in partnership with Stephen Curry's Unanimous Media and iHeart Women's Sports.


Ashanti Plummer is a sports media entrepreneur, host and former professional basketball player whose work sits at the intersection of sports, culture and entertainment. A former Division I athlete, Ashanti has transformed her experience on the court into a growing career in media, becoming a trusted voice and personality within the women’s basketball space. She has hosted and created content for some of the biggest brands and platforms in sports, while building a personal brand centered on storytelling, community, and elevating women’s sports. As co-host of iHeart Women Sports and Unanimous Media’s "Fudd Around and Find Out" alongside Azzi Fudd, Ashanti brings the perspective of a former player, creator and lifelong student of the game to conversations that go beyond basketball. Through her work in hosting, content, brand partnerships and live experiences, she continues to build her own lane in sports media while helping push women’s sports culture forward.


**About iHeart Women’s Sports**


Founded in 2024 by iHeartMedia and Deep Blue Sports + Entertainment, iHeart Women’s Sports has already made a significant impact in the women’s sports media landscape. In just one year, iHeart raised women's sports coverage from less than one percent in 2024 to more than 34 percent in 2025, reaching 89 million monthly listeners across nearly 500 broadcast radio stations. As women’s sports viewership continues to rise, iHeartMedia has remained dedicated to ensuring fair representation in media, with 50 percent of all newly produced sports podcasts focusing on women's sports coverage. Since launch, iHeart Women’s Sports has achieved 99 percent positive sentiment across social media, released more than 4,100 weekly women’s sports radio reports and launched 20 podcasts. To find all the iHeart Women’s Sports coverage, visit[iHeart Women's Sports Podcasts](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/networks/iheart-womens-sports-267/) . All shows on the network are published by iHeartPodcasts and available on the iHeartRadio app and everywhere podcasts are heard.


**About Unanimous Media**


Founded by four-time NBA champion and two-time MVP Stephen Curry and multi-creative Erick Peyton in 2018, Unanimous Media is a multimedia company rooted in the mission to produce content that challenges, inspires and elevates. Driven by purpose, Unanimous amplifies compelling family, faith and sports narratives across a range of mediums — from film to podcasts and publishing. The company has a multi-year, Global Talent Partnerships agreement with Comcast NBCUniversal – the first deal of its kind for the media giant. Most recently, Unanimous Media released Mr. Throwback for Peacock, marking Curry’s acting debut and reaching #1 on the platform. Previous projects include Stephen Curry: Underrated, Apple TV+’s documentary about Curry’s rise to prominence, Good Times, an animated reimagination of the classic sitcom on Netflix, the Academy Award-winning The Queen of Basketball, Holey Moley on ABC and more. In 2025, Unanimous Media and iHeartMedia launched the Unanimous Podcast Slate with their debut show G.O.T.E., hosted by Seth Curry and Travonne Edwards. Upcoming, Unanimous Media will release GOAT, the animated feature with Sony Pictures Animation which will release in theaters during NBA All-Star Weekend in February 2026. On September 9, the company will also release the book SHOT READY, a powerful distillation of Curry’s transformative philosophy of success.
